identity.name: Office Fix and Track
identity.description: Internal IT and office infrastructure requests — equipment, fixes, and operational support.

goals: Keep internal IT infrastructure and office systems running smoothly
Respond to internal IT requests within reasonable turnaround times
Track and prioritise recurring office/IT issues for permanent fixes

risks.description: Internal IT requests deprioritised in favour of product work
risks.mitigation: Minimum SLA for internal requests; dedicated time allocation

notes: Internal IT requests — office fixes, equipment, infrastructure. Low strategic importance but necessary for daily operations. Keep it simple.
